rules: Historical phase names remain only as evidence identifiers.
New work must have a stable capability ID, falsifiable gate, hard resource budget, baselines, metamorphic tests, and explicit claim boundary.
Task-specific score gains do not count unless the same learned mechanism transfers across held-out entities, compositions, or domains.
A downstream capability must preserve every dependency declared frozen; relearning a dependency disqualifies promotion even when task accuracy is perfect.

capabilities.name: leave-one-domain-out statistical transfer
capabilities.boundary: positive for code and prose; negative for structured data

capabilities.name: weakly supervised relational meaning invariance
capabilities.boundary: tokenized controlled clauses; not unrestricted Japanese understanding

capabilities.name: raw controlled-Japanese clause and argument grounding
capabilities.boundary: finite controlled Japanese grammar; inherited closed relation vocabulary
